## Projects

All four run on the author's own server. The two applications with a backend have a
one-click demo login on their sign-in page; no password is needed.

- [Wirehouse](https://portfolio.front.warehouse.amirjon.uz) (2026): stock and cash accounting for a wholesale food trader. Symfony 7.3 + API Platform 4 + PostgreSQL API; Vue 3 + Tailwind client with Android (Capacitor), desktop (Electron) and ESC/POS receipt printing. Money is never a float and never summed across the two currencies; sales are allocated FIFO over batches; four append-only ledgers; pessimistic locks in a fixed order on every posting path; 127 test files. API: https://portfolio.api.warehouse.amirjon.uz/api. Code: https://github.com/amirjonss/warehouse-api, https://github.com/amirjonss/warehouse-front.
- [KH Agency CRM](https://portfolio.front.smm-agency.amirjon.uz) (2025–2026): content-planning CRM for an SMM agency. Symfony 7.4 + API Platform 4 + MariaDB + Redis; Mercure pushes board changes over SSE in real time; Messenger runs reports and a daily Telegram digest in the background; Quasar client with kanban boards, a content calendar, three roles and PDF export. API: https://portfolio.api.smm-agency.amirjon.uz/api. Code: https://github.com/amirjonss/smm-crm-api, https://github.com/amirjonss/smm-crm-front.
- [Blender course](https://portfolio.front.blender.amirjon.uz) (2022–2024): landing site for a 3D course in Uzbek — sections with 3D renders, a YouTube portfolio gallery, pricing and support. Quasar SPA on a responsive grid. Frontend only. Code: https://github.com/amirjonss/blender-course-front.
- [Renthouse](https://portfolio.front.renthouse.amirjon.uz) (2022): marketplace for renting cottages — catalogue, cottage pages with Google Maps, favourites, owner cabinet, three interface languages. Quasar SPA. Frontend only. Code: https://github.com/amirjonss/renthouse-front.

## Experience

- Full-Stack Developer (contract), KH Agency — Oct 2025–present, remote. Designed and delivered a production CRM for an SMM agency with 30+ active users; saves 2–3 hours of daily operations and $1,944/year on third-party tools. Symfony 7, API Platform, RBAC, Messenger + Redis, Telegram reporting, Vue.js SPA, Docker, GitLab CI/CD, Ubuntu 24.04 server.
- PHP Web Developer (full-time), JooL Pay, Lithuania — Oct 2024–Apr 2025, remote. Backend of a QR-code tipping payment platform: new payment provider with crypto support, monthly donation auto-charging, refactoring, unit tests.
- Full Stack Developer (full-time), The Kadirov Group, Tashkent — Jan 2022–Jul 2024, remote. Boshqar.com (trade automation: DB performance, API architecture) and AstraCode.net (education platform: users, courses, chat; Redis, Elasticsearch).
- Web Development Instructor (part-time), KadirovDev IT Academy — Jan 2022–Jul 2024, remote. Groups of 20, three cohorts graduated through a six-month intensive; PHP, JavaScript, Symfony, API Platform, Vue.js.
